company.shortDescription: SKKYN Technologies DMCC is a Dubai-based on-demand car wash and auto-care platform
company.description: SKKYN Technologies DMCC is a Dubai-based on-demand car wash and auto-care platform launched in 2017. The company provides eco-friendly, waterless car wash services that customers can book through its mobile app for home, office, or other locations across Dubai. SKKYN focuses on convenience, sustainability, and professional vehicle care using biodegradable imported cleaning products and trained service staff.
